title: Her New York apartment and romances: Sprat and Al
summary: She lived in an apartment on 117th Street, doing some 'heavy rooming'. Asked about romance, she says Sprat visited her in Buffalo and Albany, nobody was around in Cincinnati, and in New York there was only Al.
